resolved_conflicts.explanation: The brief's west_us_lookouts position (44.97766, -117.38825) differs from the register's (44.97303, -117.38975). The NGS datasheet position for RED KNOB LOH matches the register, so the register position is kept.
The register gives 5,121 ft (1,561 m); the NGS datasheet gives 1562.0 m (5125 ft) as a NAVD 88 height. The story uses the register figure and notes the survey figure is slightly higher.

notes_for_editor: The removed-versus-destroyed disagreement for 1968 is between firetower.org and firelookout.com and is reported as a disagreement in the story. The 1939 staffing comes from a newspaper as quoted on the Forest Lookouts page; the newspaper itself was not read (Historic Oregon Newspapers would confirm). No source describes the site today beyond the NGS survey record, and no access level is sourced, so no access key is given. The brief's west_us_lookouts coordinate was not checked against its own source page.
